procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 4 was represented by Livia Ciampinelli.
GER 79 was represented by Reamonn Theiner.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 4 of the 470 yellow fleet were 16 knots of wind and waves of 1 metre.
10 seconds before the start GER 79 and ITA 4 were sailing towards the starting line close to the pin end at a distance of two boat lengths from the line.
ITA 4 was sailing on starboard tack and GER 79 approached the line on port tack.

When GER 79 was half a boat length from ITA 4, GER 79 tacked to leeward of ITA 4, and after completing the tack was then overlapped at a distance of 1 metre of ITA 4 and one quarter of a boat length ahead.
There was no contact between the boats.
The Race Committee scored ITA 4 and GER 79 as UFD.
conclusions: After passing head to wind and before reaching a close-hauled course, GER 79 kept clear of ITA 4. GER 79 did not break RRS 13.
When acquiring right-of-way through her own actions, GER 79 initially gave ITA 4 room to keep clear, and did not break RRS 15.
ITA 4’s score in race 4 was not made significantly worse by the incident. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 64.1(b) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to ITA 4.
